# Compatibility matrix

Endpoint coverage is generated by comparing kinglet routes against the official Google REST discovery document for each service.

| Service | Status | API version | Endpoint coverage | Data plane | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [AlloyDB](services/alloydb.md) | Experimental | v1 | 23/40 (57%) | Control plane only | Cluster, instance, and user CRUD with LRO operations — no connectable PostgreSQL server. |
| [Cloud Tasks](services/cloud-tasks.md) | Implemented | v2 | 16/18 (89%) | Emulated in-process | Queue lifecycle, task CRUD, and HTTP dispatch. |
| [Cloud Scheduler](services/cloud-scheduler.md) | Implemented | v1 | 10/16 (63%) | Emulated in-process | Job CRUD, pause/resume, and cron execution. |
| [Memorystore for Valkey](services/memorystore.md) | Experimental | v1 | Discovery doc unavailable | Real valkey-server (optional) | Instance, ACL, backup, and token-auth CRUD; optional real Valkey data plane on by default. |
| [Secret Manager](services/secret-manager.md) | Planned | v1 | Not started | Not started | Config flag exists; service is a stub with no routes yet. |
| [Cloud Pub/Sub](services/pubsub.md) | Implemented | v1 | 34/34 (100%) | Emulated in-process | Topics, subscriptions, publish/pull, ack, snapshots, schemas, and seek. |
| [Cloud Storage](services/cloud-storage.md) | Experimental | v1 | 15/78 (19%) | File-backed objects | Bucket CRUD, object upload/download, copy, compose, and rewrite. |
| [Cloud Workflows](services/workflows.md) | Experimental | v1 | 11/11 (100%) | Emulated in-process | Workflow CRUD, revisions, and LRO operations. |
| [Cloud KMS](services/cloud-kms.md) | Implemented | v1 | 24/71 (34%) | Emulated in-process | Key rings, crypto keys/versions, symmetric encrypt/decrypt, asymmetric sign/decrypt, MAC, random bytes. |
| [Cloud SQL](services/cloud-sql.md) | Implemented | v1 | 20/75 (27%) | Control plane only | Instance, database, and user admin API — PostgreSQL only; instances are records, not connectable servers. |

## Status legend

- **Implemented** — validated against real client libraries and production-style workflows.
- **Experimental** — API surface exists but has not been fully validated; breaking changes may occur.
- **Planned** — not yet implemented.

## How coverage is calculated

Coverage counts discovery-document REST methods with a matching kinglet route (same HTTP method and path shape). IAM policy methods (`getIamPolicy`, `setIamPolicy`, `testIamPermissions`) are tracked separately and excluded from the percentage.
